name: prompt-recap
description: Your prompts, what you added mid-turn and how each turn ended, plus the session's goal, what's happening now, what's waiting on you and the next step, in a pane beside the chat. Press a prompt to jump back to it.

summary.title: Turn summaries
summary.description: on: after each of your turns a small model (Haiku) writes the turn's summary and the session's goal, waiting and next step. off: no model calls; the reply's first line stands in. /prompt-recap summary on|off changes it too.
